title: The conjectured exact closed-rich constant of the Fibonacci word
statement:
Let $f$ be the infinite Fibonacci word, let $C_f$ be its closed-rich constant, and let $\phi=\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ be the golden ratio. **Fibonacci closed-rich constant conjecture.** For $f$,

$$
C_f=\frac{5\phi+3}{\phi^2(\phi^3+2)^2}\approx0.10893.
$$

This conjecture is presented as a consequence of the preceding conjectured formula for the first-difference sequence. The paper does not report a proof or a resolution.
source_name: Anuran Maity and Svetlana Puzynina, “Bounds on the closed-rich constant of infinite words”, arXiv:2605.19535 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19535

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2026).
